name: Syrian Visual Identity WebMCP
description: Official Web Model Context Protocol (WebMCP) tool registry and specification for the Syrian Visual Identity.

tools.name: get_color_palette
tools.description: Returns the complete Syrian Visual Identity color system (HEX, RGB, CMYK, Pantone, CSS variables, and usage rules).

tools.name: get_logo
tools.description: Returns Syrian national emblem and visual identity logo URLs, vector details, and inline SVG markup with safety margins.

tools.name: get_flag_specs
tools.description: Returns official constitutional Syrian Flag technical specifications: 2:3 ratio, exact tricolor dimensions, and 3 red stars geometry with vector SVG.

tools.name: get_governorate_landmark
tools.description: Returns the architectural emblem, landmark name, history, and SVG icon for any of the 14 Syrian governorates.

tools.name: get_brand_rules
tools.description: Returns official compliance dos and don'ts for Syrian visual identity typography, emblem spacing, color contrast, and flag respect guidelines.
